interpretation: Normative standalone use catalog with expected typed action inputs, observed output fields, existing scratchpad-field declarations and named type definitions. Every activity remains an independent entry in the existing shuffled order. No action inheritance or parent-child relationships.

opcode_format.order: Section hierarchy followed by clause order

procedures.imperative: Interpret a permitted action's expected_input as the typed information needed to perform or document that action, not as the data type of the action's explanatory sentence.
Select any relevant permitted action independently; do not infer parentage, adjacency semantics, or scratchpad-index allocation from catalog order or reused type definitions.
Use previously registered named object types as input contracts; action-specific fields may refine expected inputs without creating redundant named object types.
Do not require every listed input, activity, or registered type in every scratchpad; absent optional inputs do not invalidate unrelated recorded content.

Keep the AGENTS.md root array, minimum seventeen items, and literal scratchpad wrapper contract in effect; this catalog refines activities and input types but does not supersede the structural requirements.
